Place the single-header Clay library here as `clay.h`.

Recommended upstream: https://github.com/nicbarker/clay

For example:
- Download `clay.h` from the repo and save it to this folder.
- Then build the clay environment:
  - pio run -e esp32dev_clay
  - pio run -e esp32dev_clay -t upload

Note: The default firmware environment does not compile this renderer.
